turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration: Bartolomhew's warm smile doesn't waver as he regards the offered boots. "I appreciate the thought, truly," he says, his voice carrying that same paternal ease, "but those are yours now. A small gesture, perhaps, but I'd rather you kept them." He makes no move to take the boots back, and his hands remain calmly at his sides. "Consider it a welcome, however modest, to your new circumstances."
